title: Jagged Mustardy Dutch Peas Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew featuring split peas, nuka-pickle, and a tangy mustardy flavor. Perfect for a sick-day.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the diced carrot and celery and sauté for 5 minutes.
Add the nuka-pickle, dried split peas, yellow mustard, and chicken broth.
Stir well to combine and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add water to reach the desired consistency and season with black pepper.
Continue to simmer for another 10-15 minutes or until the peas are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
